title: LIFE IS GOD'S GIFT
openLoop: What really decides the value of your life

recap.title: Live long — live on purpose
items: You are not an accident — life is offered by God
Every breath is borrowed from God
Your value is the life God put in you
Without God, even a full life is empty

scenes.point: You are not an accident — your life is offered by God
scenes.teaser: Where did your life really begin?

scenes.point: Before work, before a home, before a garden — God gave you life
scenes.teaser: What does AI prove about you?

scenes.point: The Author of your life is the only One who can define its purpose
scenes.teaser: What gives a life its value?

scenes.point: Every human life has value — because God put His life in it
Not your age, ability, or success — the life God put in you
